line_items.reasoning: Q4 revenue came in at $39.3B, clearly exceeding the guided $37.5B +/- 2% (implied range of ~$36.75B–$38.25B) by roughly $1.8B above the top end.
Non-GAAP gross margin of 73.5% landed exactly at the midpoint of the guided 73.5% +/- 50bps range, a perfect match to guidance.
While no explicit EPS guidance was given, the revenue beat and inline margins on a higher revenue base would have driven EPS above any implied baseline, and the reaffirmed tax rate guidance was met.
No explicit deviation from guided GAAP opex of ~$4.8B or non-GAAP opex of ~$3.4B was reported in the results, suggesting spending tracked in line with guidance.

Gaming declined 22% sequentially (consistent with the guided sequential decline due to supply constraints), but Networking also declined 3% sequentially rather than returning to the guided sequential growth, missing that specific call.
